heading: About Clark Performance
intro: Head of Physical Performance & Injury Prevention at Løvenstad Football Club, where I oversee player development through strength & conditioning, injury prevention strategies, and performance optimization.
body:
I hold a Bachelor’s degree in Sports Science from NTNU in Trondheim, Norway, and a Master’s degree in Strength & Conditioning from Leeds Beckett University (UK).

My international experience includes working in high-performance and academy environments such as Leeds United Academy, i2i International Soccer Academy (UK), and California State University, Northridge (CSUN) in Los Angeles — working with NCAA Division 1 full-scholarship athletes across multiple sports including basketball, football, track & field, baseball, tennis, volleyball, water polo and softball.
